trigger_conditions.observation: A reviewed activation input, digest, network binding, or approval is absent or mismatched.
trigger_conditions.required_response: Abort the activation attempt and retain the disabled runtime state.

trigger_conditions.observation: A canary observes unauthorized acceptance, authenticated rejection beyond its approved threshold, or identity-binding drift.
trigger_conditions.required_response: Deny new paid-work ingress and enter the operator-confirmed rollback sequence.

trigger_conditions.observation: The reviewed listener, service state, persistence state, or health evidence differs from the approved canary scope.
trigger_conditions.required_response: Deny new paid-work ingress and enter the operator-confirmed rollback sequence.

trigger_conditions.observation: Work dispatch, payment execution, Work Credit accounting, signer access, or fund-movement evidence violates an approved invariant.
trigger_conditions.required_response: Deny new work and economic writes, preserve evidence, and enter the operator-confirmed rollback sequence.

trigger_conditions.observation: An explicitly authorized operator requests emergency containment.
trigger_conditions.required_response: Enter the operator-confirmed rollback sequence without automatic reactivation.

rollback_sequence.objective: Bind the approved configuration instance, service design, canary scope, credential-reference lifecycle, rollback receipt destination, and explicit operator authority.
rollback_sequence.success_evidence: All referenced artifact identifiers and digests match their separately reviewed values.
rollback_sequence.on_failure: Stop; retain or restore the disabled state and escalate for review.

rollback_sequence.objective: Fail closed for new authenticated paid-work admission before changing service state.
rollback_sequence.success_evidence: The approved ingress control reports that new paid-work admission is denied.
rollback_sequence.on_failure: Stop; isolate the approved ingress boundary and escalate for review.

rollback_sequence.objective: Apply the separately approved configuration mechanism so enabled and activation-authorized state are both false.
rollback_sequence.success_evidence: The bound configuration evidence reports enabled=false and activation_authorized=false.
rollback_sequence.on_failure: Stop; keep ingress denied, prevent restart, and escalate for review.

rollback_sequence.objective: Use the separately reviewed service-unit design to stop the paid-work runtime and prevent automatic restart.
rollback_sequence.success_evidence: The reviewed service-state evidence reports inactive and automatic restart disabled.
rollback_sequence.on_failure: Stop; keep ingress denied, preserve diagnostics, and escalate for review.

rollback_sequence.objective: Use the separately reviewed credential lifecycle to detach runtime access by reference without printing, copying, or reading secret material.
rollback_sequence.success_evidence: The credential-reference lifecycle reports detached or inaccessible to the stopped runtime without exposing a secret.
rollback_sequence.on_failure: Stop; keep runtime and ingress disabled and escalate to the credential authority.

rollback_sequence.objective: Preserve identifiers and evidence for incomplete work or payment state while prohibiting automated settlement, credit write, signer use, or fund movement.
rollback_sequence.success_evidence: Every in-flight identifier is accounted for as absent, finalized before the trigger, or quarantined for manual reconciliation.
rollback_sequence.on_failure: Stop; preserve evidence, prohibit economic writes and fund movement, and escalate for reconciliation.

rollback_sequence.objective: Verify no paid-work listener, runtime process, automatic restart, credential availability, work dispatch, payment execution, Work Credit write, signer access, or fund movement remains enabled.
rollback_sequence.success_evidence: All exact disabled-state success criteria are observed from the separately approved verification mechanisms.
rollback_sequence.on_failure: Keep containment in place and escalate; do not claim rollback completion.

rollback_sequence.objective: Record the trigger, reviewed input digests, step outcomes, final disabled-state observations, and operator confirmation without secret material.
rollback_sequence.success_evidence: A closed, non-secret JSON receipt is durably recorded at the separately approved destination.
rollback_sequence.on_failure: Keep containment in place and escalate; do not reactivate.

rollback_sequence.objective: Return the lane to HOLD until a fresh readiness evaluation and separate activation-execution approval are reviewed.
rollback_sequence.success_evidence: No automatic restart or reactivation is authorized and the current activation decision is HOLD.
rollback_sequence.on_failure: Keep containment in place and escalate; automatic reactivation remains forbidden.

fail_closed_conditions.response: Do not execute; retain the disabled state and escalate.
Do not execute the affected step; retain containment and escalate.
Prohibit automated settlement, credit write, signer use, and fund movement; quarantine evidence for manual reconciliation.
Do not claim completion or reactivate; retain containment and escalate.
Do not reactivate; preserve local evidence and escalate.
